tools.name: webclock_list_employees
tools.description: List all employees defined in WebClock, active and terminated, with pay group, department, pay type and hire/term dates.

tools.name: webclock_get_time_clock
tools.description: Return time-clock records (punch times, rounded times, hours, approvals) for a date range. Dates are MM/DD/YYYY.

tools.name: webclock_get_timesheets
tools.description: Return timesheet records for a date range: hours by pay code, client, task and shift, with lock and approval status. Dates are MM/DD/YYYY.

tools.name: webclock_get_time_off_requests
tools.description: Return time-off requests in a date range, optionally filtered by status or employee ID. Dates are MM/DD/YYYY.

tools.name: webclock_get_time_off_requests_admin
tools.description: Return all time-off records in a date range, including administrative fields such as create date and last updated by. Dates end with a time: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM.

tools.name: webclock_whos_in_out
tools.description: Return the current in/out status of employees: last in, last out, current status (1 in, 2 out), activity and time-off flag.

tools.name: webclock_get_license
tools.description: Return the license count and the number of active users for the WebClock client.

tools.name: webclock_get_time_summary
tools.description: Return summed time totals across a date range, optionally per week or month and grouped by department. The end date ends with a time.

tools.name: webclock_get_schedules
tools.description: Return employee schedule records for a date range, with optional filters by employee, pay group or department. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: webclock_get_anomalies
tools.description: Return shift anomalies such as missing punches for a date range. The end date ends with a time.

tools.name: webclock_get_hr_certifications
tools.description: Return HR certifications and class history for employees: class, institution, credits, completion date and cost.

tools.name: webclock_get_accrual_balances
tools.description: Return the current accrual balances by employee and accrual type.

tools.name: webclock_get_payroll_data
tools.description: Return payroll-ready records for one pay group over a date range: units, rates, pay codes and PTO balance. Dates are MM/DD/YYYY.

tools.name: webclock_list_locations
tools.description: Return the configured work-location list for the client, with sub-locations and descriptions.

tools.name: webclock_list_tasks
tools.description: Return the configured task list for the client, with sub-tasks and effective dates.

tools.name: webclock_list_job_functions
tools.description: Return the HR job-function definitions for the client.
